title: Concept: .NET stack frame with source path disclosed in a response
description: A response discloses a .NET stack frame with a source path. The developer exception page is convenient during development and catastrophic in production: it names internal types, exposes the build directory and often includes configuration values in the surrounding output.
applicability: ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core applications that render developer exception pages.
risk: Internal type names and build paths disclosed; MEDIUM severity.
